Class AmwpPeekStream

java.lang.Object
java.io.InputStream
org.aetheris.wire.AmwpPeekStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class AmwpPeekStream extends InputStream
The AmwpPeekStream class is the only reader of an SSH byte stream. A daemon thread named amwp-byte-pump blocks on the source and queues each byte. A timed peek does not call available(). Apache MINA pipes often report 0 from available() until a blocking read. // @aa-sdd G-18 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

    • AmwpPeekStream

      public AmwpPeekStream(InputStream src)
      The constructor starts the pump thread on the source stream. This object becomes the only reader of that stream. The thread is a daemon.
      Parameters:
      src - The source is the SSH byte stream.

  • Method Details

    • pollByte

      public int pollByte(long timeoutMs)
      The method waits up to the timeout for the next byte. A byte pushed back by unread is returned first. No byte before the timeout returns TIMEOUT. An interrupt returns TIMEOUT and restores the interrupt flag. End of stream is -1.
      Parameters:
      timeoutMs - The timeout is the wait in milliseconds.
      Returns:
      The return value is 0 through 255, -1 at end of stream, or TIMEOUT.

    • unread

      public void unread(int b)
      The method pushes one byte back for the next read() or pollByte(long). A later push replaces the earlier one.
      Parameters:
      b - The value is a byte, or -1 for end of stream.

    • read

      public int read(byte[] buf, int off, int len) throws IOException
      The method fills a buffer from the queue without waiting after the first byte. A null buffer returns 0. A length of 0 or less returns 0. End of stream on the first byte returns -1. A later queued end of stream is pushed back and stops the copy.
      Overrides:
      read in class InputStream
      Parameters:
      buf - The buffer receives the bytes, and it may be null.
      off - The offset is the first index to write.
      len - The length is the maximum number of bytes to write.
      Returns:
      The return value is the number of bytes written, or -1 at end of stream.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method declares this to match InputStream.read(byte[], int, int).

    • available

      public int available()
      The method returns how many bytes are already queued. A pushed-back byte adds one to that count. The count does not ask the source stream.
      Overrides:

      Returns:

    • pumpLoop

      private void pumpLoop()
      The method blocks on the source and queues each byte as 0 through 255. End of stream queues -1 and returns. A closed stream stops the loop before the next read. Any other failure also queues -1. An interrupt while queueing that failure restores the interrupt flag.
